title: validate.mjs enforces the full coverage contract's shape
goal: Make validate.mjs and backlog.schema.json reject any malformed coverage object, unconditionally.
in_scope: Add coverage.targets to backlog.schema.json's coverage property (id/cwd/command/summary required, lcov optional, additionalProperties: false)

Add a validateCoverage(coverage) function to validate.mjs checking: coverage is an object; mode is one of off|warn|enforce; min is a finite number 0..1; command is a non-empty string when present; stacks is an array of non-empty strings; targets is an array of well-formed, uniquely-id'd objects
Call validateCoverage(data.coverage) unconditionally (never gated behind legacyContractGrace)
out_of_scope: Any change to coverage.mjs's runtime behavior (that is S-2/S-3)
Any change to the existing done-story coverage.min enforcement block in validate.mjs (unchanged)
acceptance: Invalid coverage.mode, out-of-range coverage.min, blank coverage.command, non-string coverage.stacks entries, and malformed coverage.targets entries (missing fields, duplicate ids) all fail validate.mjs with a specific error, even when legacyContractGrace is active.
invariants: A backlog.json with no coverage key at all must still pass (backward compatible)
A valid { min, mode } shape with no targets must still pass unchanged
